name: Shimmer Body Oil
blurb: Cedarwood, sweet orange, and patchouli under a black-gold shimmer that photographs as good as it feels. That's the Seduction blend, one of three scents this comes in. Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and built for festivals, Pride, and anywhere else you plan on shining harder than everyone around you.

usageGuide.howToApply: Shake bottle vigorously before each use. Dispense 3–5 drops into palms and smooth over collarbones, shoulders, arms, and legs for instant hydration and radiant glow.
usageGuide.storage: Store upright at room temperature away from direct sunlight. Shelf life is 12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Contains cosmetic mica and fragrance. Apply 1 drop to inner wrist and wait 24 hours before full body application.
